categories.label: LEGO
categories.title: The Builders
categories.blurb: LEGO sets for the man who deserves a slow weekend.
categories.aside: I've watched a grown man disappear into a thousand-piece set on a Sunday afternoon and come out calmer than any meditation app has ever made me. There's a reason these aren't toys.

products.name: LEGO Pirates of the Caribbean — Black Pearl
products.why: He watched this movie as a kid. He'll build it as a man.

products.name: LEGO Architecture — Statue of Liberty
products.why: For the guy who has a place he still wants to go.

products.name: LEGO Nintendo Game Boy
products.why: Every guy remembers his first game. This is that memory, built.

products.name: LEGO Architecture — Paris Skyline
products.why: He'll put it on his shelf and think of the trip he wants to take with you.

products.name: LEGO Architecture — Himeji Castle
products.why: Quiet, precise, and a little obsessive. Just like him.

products.name: LEGO Architecture — Taj Mahal
products.why: 2,000 pieces. He won't rush it. That's the whole point.

products.name: LEGO Icons — Ford Model T
products.why: For the man who appreciates things that were built to last.

products.name: LEGO Botanical — Rose Bouquet
products.why: Flowers that will never wilt, from someone who never forgets.

products.name: LEGO Botanical — Japanese Maple Bonsai
products.why: Desk decor he'll actually keep. For years.

products.name: LEGO Icons — Polaroid OneStep Camera
products.why: He'll build it in an afternoon and display it like a trophy.

products.name: LEGO Botanical — Cactus
products.why: Low maintenance. High character. Exactly his kind of plant.

products.name: LEGO Botanical — Peace Lily
products.why: Something calm for his corner. He'll notice it every morning.

products.name: LEGO Icons — Land Rover Defender

products.name: LEGO Icons — Porsche 911

products.name: LEGO Architecture — Trafalgar Square

products.name: LEGO Icons — Chevrolet Corvette
products.why: The car he talks about. Finally something to show for it.

categories.label: Minecraft
categories.title: The Pixel Years
categories.blurb: Minecraft things from the world he built when he was twelve.
categories.aside: The men who grew up inside Minecraft don't always say it out loud. But hand them an axolotl plush and watch their face. Some childhoods don't end — they just get folded up small enough to fit on a desk.

products.name: Zombie Riding Chicken Jockey Plush
products.why: He'll laugh out loud. Then keep it on his desk forever.

products.name: Wolf Companion Plush
products.why: He tamed one at age eleven. He never forgot it.

products.name: 8-Piece Mob Plush Collection
products.why: Every character he remembers. All in one box.

products.name: Bee Plush
products.why: Small. Soft. Completely disarms him. That's the gift.

products.name: Wolf LED Mood Lamp
products.why: His room, but with the one thing it was missing.

products.name: Fox LED Mood Lamp
products.why: Warm light. Quiet corner. Exactly the vibe he's going for.

products.name: Axolotl Plush
products.why: The most loved creature in the game. Watch his face when he opens this.

categories.label: For the Good Life
categories.title: Quiet Upgrades
categories.blurb: Quiet upgrades for the parts of his day no one sees.
categories.aside: These are the things he won't buy himself. Not because he doesn't want them — because he's the kind of guy who waits. So you don't wait. You just put one in his life and watch him reach for it every evening.

products.name: Royal Reserve Whiskey Stones Set
products.why: His Friday nights, upgraded. No melt. No compromise.

products.name: Bellroy Hide & Seek Leather Wallet
products.why: He's had the same wallet for years. He won't replace it himself.

products.name: Victrola Highland 4-in-1 Bluetooth Record Player
products.why: He'll play it every night. And think of you every time.

products.name: Magcubic HY300 Pro Mini Projector
products.why: Movie nights that actually feel like movie nights.

products.name: Hydro Flask 32oz — Wide Mouth
products.why: Cold for 24 hours. He'll reach for it every single morning.
